figures.caption: Fig. 2: Overview of Mastermind’s Dual-loop Framework. Starting from a task, 1) the Curator activates experience and passes it to the Planner. 2) The Planner emits the current best strategy, 3) the Executor turns that strategy into a PoC rollout, and 4) the Verifier validates the PoC, then closes two loops: 5) it updates Curator for the next attempt and 6) supplies feedback signals to the Planner. Repeated iterations refine the strategy until a verified PoC is obtained.
